intent: Review a 3 mm outward independent copy of the expression-backed authored circle on the same symbolic datum plane, then extrude only the copy by 6 mm.
steps: Add parameters by DesignPatch, create sketch:new_1 and feature:sketch_new_1 on the existing feature:datum with current document identity/revision, then apply the primitives and the source horizontal constraint through verified patch/history gateways.
Create feature:offset_source_body as a 6 mm NewBody of profile:circle:ent:offset_disc. This is the native fixture: examples/selected_offset.ocad.d contains the original source before any copy.

Read inspect_sketches.offset_targets. Call plan_sketch_offset with the offset intent and current document_id/revision. Review the concrete fresh sketch/owner/curve/point IDs, 13 mm radius at (2,-3) mm, original symbolic datum plane, closed profile and unchanged original 600*pi mm3 solid. Review must not write.

Call apply_sketch_offset with the identical intent/revision and opaque history. A single atomic patch creates the independent copy and authored owner. No constraints or curve association are copied. Undo/Redo restores complete canonical source.

Create feature:offset_body as a 6 mm NewBody extrusion of the backend-returned copy's closed profile. The result is V=1014*pi mm3, A=494*pi mm2. Editing diameter later leaves the copy coordinates/radius unchanged; editing the shared datum moves both sketches.

For a rectangle instead, select rectangle_curve_ids in exactly that CCW order: +3 mm gives 86 by 66 mm, -3 mm gives 74 by 54 mm. Open/reordered/reversed selections, non-tangent/concave contours and collapsed insets refuse without publishing. Distance must be a positive constant explicit length; choose side separately.
compatibility: ADR-110 and ADR-052; existing bounded independent-copy offset, ordinary authored lines/arcs/circles only, no geometry/sampler/schema admission or persistent curve association.
